title: ononis pendula subsp. boissieri
intro: Ononis pendula subsp. boissieri, commonly known as the Spurred Restharrow, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, infections, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Ononis pendula subsp. boissieri are attributed to its ability to stimulate blood circulation, reduce pain and swelling, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
